messages:
maya: Heads up — working on a Private/VPC metrics export feature for customers who want to ship runtime + infra metrics out of their VPC. Need input on agents, firewall constraints, KMS/audit hooks, and what the console needs for dashboards. Proposed minimal exports: prometheus remote_write, S3-compatible object drops, syslog. Thoughts?

raj: quick clarifying q — where do metrics originate? runtime exposes /metrics and we run an agent sidecar that scrapes? or do we push directly from the runtime?

sophia: security perspective: must be egress-only from the customer's network. We should support mTLS with customer-provided CA or customer-owned certs, and require envelope encryption using customer KMS (wrap/unwrap). Audit logs must capture export_job_id, destination, timestamps, and a SHA256 of the payload for tamper evidence.

jess: runtime notes — we can instrument to expose a local Prometheus endpoint (127.0.0.1:9100) for agents to scrape. For private/on-prem some customers won't allow sidecars, so support an agentless push via a signed POST is useful. We can add a small signer component to runtime that signs payloads with the customer envelope key.

anton: console/UX ask — dashboards need tenant_id, cluster_id, model_version tags on every series. Also we should surface: last_successful_push, export_lag_seconds, and recent_errors per-destination. Need metrics that let us build a health panel for exports.

raj: network/firewall bits — most customers will want to allowlist a destination IP range. For push flows we need outbound TCP 443 (TLS). For pull/scrape flows we'd need private peering or customer opens inbound from our collector IPs (unlikely for VPC). So design for push-first. Agents must support: proxy envs, DNS over TLS issues, and exponential backoff with jitter.

sophia: KMS details — we need two modes: (1) customer-managed KMS where our export agent requests a data-encryption-key (DEK) encrypted under customer KEK; (2) customer supplies an HSM-backed signing key for audit stamping. For mode (1) we store only encrypted DEKs and never see plaintext. Also record KMS key_id in audit logs and include key rotation events.

jess: putting a quick agent config example (for agent sidecar push). Not perfect but captures fields we need:
```yaml
agent:
  name: redwood-export-agent
  scrape_target: http://127.0.0.1:9100/metrics
  remote_write:
    - url: https://metrics.receiver.example.com/api/v1/write
      tls:
        ca_file: /etc/agent/ca.pem   # customer-provided CA
        client_cert: /etc/agent/cert.pem
        client_key: /etc/agent/key.pem
      headers:
        X-Export-Job: job-12345
      backoff:
        initial: 1s
        max: 5m
  s3_drop:
    - bucket: customer-exports
      path_template: "{{tenant_id}}/{{cluster}}/{{ts}}.ndjson"
      kms_key_id: arn:aws:kms:...
```

anton: console needs to accept those labels and let customers map fields (tenant->team). Also add a toggle in the UI to opt-in to export telemetry + audit-level retention policy UI. Can't show raw payloads — only metadata and hashes.

alex: SE/customer-ops note — make sure our onboarding doc has firewall checklist: outbound to X IPs, whitelist domain, required ports, proxy env vars, sample cert rotation steps. Customers often ask for an allowlist of our egress IPs and a deterministic user-agent string so infra teams can filter.

raj: ops note — for canary and rollout: we should treat export as a separate feature flag and rollout per-customer. Agent changes are sensitive (network behavior), so canary to 5 customers first, then 20, then general. Also include a kill-switch we can trigger if push floods.

maya: agree on canary plan. For telemetry, we need runtime/agent to emit: export_attempts_total, export_success_total, export_bytes_sent, export_error_count, export_last_success_timestamp. Console will derive export_lag_seconds from those.

deploy-bot: canary created: feature/export-vpc -> 5 customers (id: c-102, c-341, c-512). Deployer: maya.

maya: ok — next actions: (1) raj/jess implement agent contract + backoff + metrics, (2) sophia to draft KMS/audit requirements + schema, (3) anton to mock dashboard panels + UI toggle, (4) alex to prepare firewall checklist for docs. I'll set a 30-min sync tomorrow to align. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

raj: ack — starting agent PR draft.

sophia: will post KMS spec by EOD.

jess: I'll add signer + config to runtime branch and link PR in the sync.

anton: will add wireframes to the ticket.

maya: filing RFC and scheduling sync. Link: https://rfd.internal.redwood/metrics-export-vpc (private)
